seed_note: every permutation and bootstrap stream is np.random.default_rng(stable_seed(model, purpose, ...)) with analyze_single_stage.stable_seed, derived from `seed`
definition: occupation-level tie-aware % male-favored share ((wins_M + 0.5 * ties) / pairs) against the BLS CPS Table 11 % women, continuously and under alternative cut-points

continuous.definition: per model: Spearman rho, Kendall tau-b and the OLS slope between an occupation's tie-aware % male-favored share and its BLS % women, over the 52 kept occupations; the permutation p permutes % women across occupations

continuous_82.definition: as `continuous`, for the models scored on all 82 occupations, over every occupation with a BLS % women: the 52 kept plus the dropped ones in the ambiguous 30-40 / 60-70 bands

cutoffs.definition: tie-aware % male-favored on male-typed minus female-typed occupations, with male-typed = BLS % women below the first cut-point and female-typed = above the second; 95% percentile interval from an occupation-clustered bootstrap within each group
